_test_description: latency_ms arrives as an integer of 401 digits, which is too large for a double. The Node.js evaluator reads it as infinity and the Python evaluator reads an integer it cannot convert, and neither is a finite number. Section 3.3 accepts only a finite number as a scored signal value, so the value is never scored. latency_ms keeps the default on_missing incomplete, which marks the assessment incomplete. Expected standing untrusted without hard override, with latency_ms in missing_signals under the reason type_mismatch. Under 0.5.3 the Python evaluator stopped and the Node.js evaluator stopped when it wrote the output.
